relationships.subject: H4K12la
relationships.evidence_quote: histone H4 lysine 12 lactylation (H4K12la) has been shown to exacerbate inflammation by activating the NF-κB signaling pathway [22]

relationships.subject: histone lactylation
relationships.evidence_quote: In RAW264.7 cells, lactate-induced histone lactylation suppresses the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-1β, IL-6, and tumor necrosis factor α (TNF-α), while enhancing the expression of M2 markers Arg1 and CD206

relationships.subject: p300
relationships.evidence_quote: p300 acetyltransferase, which catalyzes lactylation of histone residues such as H3 lysine 18 lactylation (H3K18la)

key_findings: Review: lactylation is a context-dependent metabolic-epigenetic regulator of macrophage polarization and chronic inflammation in musculoskeletal disorders
Proposes combining lactylation modulators with SPMs to resolve systemic chronic low-grade inflammation
